message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Meat & Protein** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef and pork) | 1–1½ lb (450–680 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional, for extra flavor) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Eggs (for the béchamel sauce) | 2 large |
| | Parmesan cheese (grated) | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Mozzarella cheese (shredded) | 4 cups (about 400 g) |
| | Optional: shredded mozzarella for topping | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Vegetables & Aromatics** | Onion (finely chopped) | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves (minced) | 3–4 |
| | Fresh basil leaves (optional) | ¼ cup (10 g) |
| | Fresh oregano leaves (optional) | ¼ cup (10 g) |
| | Salt | To taste |
| | Black pepper | To taste |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp (30 ml) |
| **Sauces & Liquids** | Canned crushed tomatoes (28 oz / 800 g) | 1 can |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp (30 g) |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup (120 ml) |
| | Water or broth (for the béchamel) | 2 cups (480 ml) |
| | Milk | 2 cups (480 ml) |
| | Butter | 4 Tbsp (60 g) |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 Tbsp (30 g) |
| **Pasta & Baking** | Lasagna noodles (no-boil or regular) | 9–12 sheets |
| | Optional: fresh spinach or other greens | 2 cups (about 100 g) |
| | Optional: mushrooms (sautéed) | 1 cup (about 70 g) |

**Optional Extras**
- **Béchamel sauce**: A creamy white sauce made from butter, flour, milk, and nutmeg.
- **Extra herbs**: A pinch of nutmeg or dried thyme.
- **Cheese blend**: Mix provolone or fontina with mozzarella for a richer flavor.

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your serving size or personal taste. Enjoy your lasagna!
